tour_experience_data.title: Tokyo Private & Personalized City Highlights and Hidden Gems Tour
tour_experience_data.act_summary:
- Your adventure will be fully personalized by your knowledgeable host, reflecting your interests.
- You could delve into the urban pulse of Shibuya, exploring its iconic landmarks and hidden side streets.
- Choose to immerse yourself in the vibrant Harajuku district, known for its eclectic markets and unique street food.
- You may prefer to wander through the historical streets of Asakusa and Ueno, filled with cultural landmarks and trendy cafes.
- Consider exploring Yanaka, a 'town within the city', blending traditional shops with creative modern establishments.
- Opt to savor authentic Japanese cuisine at a local eatery, indulging in delectable sushi, ramen, or a refreshing cup of matcha tea.

food_data.title: Tokyo: Shinjuku Food Tour- 15 Dishes and 4 Eateries
food_data.act_summary:
Dive into the lively heart of Tokyo with this Shinjuku Food Tour, where every stop reveals a new flavor and story. Over the course of the evening, you’ll visit four carefully selected local eateries around Shinjuku and Kabukicho — areas famous for their neon lights, buzzing nightlife, and endless food options.

Your local guide will take you to restaurants loved by Tokyoites, not tourists. Together, you’ll taste 15 authentic Japanese dishes, including favorites like yakitori (grilled skewers), gyoza dumplings, karaage (fried chicken), fresh sashimi, and more. Each stop offers something different — from cozy izakaya pubs to family-run diners that serve true comfort food.

food_data.title: Tokyo: Tsukiji Fish Market Street Food Tour
food_data.act_summary:
* The Heart of Tokyo’s Food Scene:
Explore Tsukiji, the historic district and must-visit destination for Japanese cuisine and local culture lovers.

* Unique Tsukiji Hongwanji Temple:
Visit this stunning temple known for its rare Indian-style architecture and deep spiritual history.

* Vibrant Outer Market:
Navigate a maze of family-run shops. Your guide leads you to fresh ingredients and hidden gems away from the crowds.

* Discover Authentic Flavors:
Learn about Wagyu, tuna, and tamagoyaki. Gain expert knowledge with the freedom to taste what you like.

* Insight into Local Traditions:
Understand Japan’s culinary heritage through stories of artisans who have preserved Tsukiji for generations.

food_data.title: 【Grand Opening】Tokyo: Guided Sake Tasting Experience (with Omakase Sushi Course)
food_data.act_summary: Discover Japanese sake through a guided tasting experience in Tokyo's East Azabu area. Taste 8 or more carefully selected types of sake from across Japan and learn about their sweetness, dryness, aroma, and unique characteristics with easy-to-understand guidance from staff. This experience also includes 10 pieces of sushi, allowing you to enjoy a delicious pairing of sake and sushi. Perfect for couples, friends, solo travelers, and anyone looking for an authentic Japanese food and cultural experience in Tokyo.
